17/03/2020 05:39

Discharge date/time: 19:29 on 15/03/2020

Discharge Summary

Diagnosis: COVID-19 pneumonia complicated by type 1 respiratory failure, confirmed by
SARS-Cov-2 PCR (swab taken 13:08 on 05/03/2020), positive result reported 20:40 on
05/03/2020).

Presenting complaint: Fever, cough and progressive breathlessness with hypoxemia (SpO2
<92% on air at 21:30 on 06/03/2020).

Hospital course: Admitted to the acute medical unit and rapidly escalated to the intensive care
unit on 06/03/2020 for CPAP respiratory support due to increasing oxygen requirement.
Enoxaparin thromboprophylaxis commenced during ICU admission, first dose given 10:00 on
06/03/2020. Did not require invasive ventilation or other organ support during the ICU stay.
Oxygenation improved over several days allowing stepdown to the ward, with subsequent
successful weaning from supplemental oxygen. Physiotherapy input supported recovery of
exercise tolerance prior to discharge.

Medications on discharge: Enoxaparin course completed prior to discharge, not continued at
home given return to full mobility. No new regular medications commenced.

Follow-up arrangements: Respiratory clinic review arranged within 2 weeks of discharge to
assess ongoing respiratory recovery given the need for CPAP support during admission.
Advise re-presentation if symptoms of respiratory deterioration recur.

GP actions: Please monitor recovery of exercise tolerance, review for any persistent
breathlessness, and support gradual return to usual activities.
